catalog.title: Seiko V1
catalog.note: JDM annual (1978 Vol.1). Each caption prints the ref (●QNL020) and list price (円), then the movement — a four-digit calibre or a family code (48GQW, 48KQW, 58KQW, 75TPW, 43TPW, 11S, 17QS, SV, 88ST …) — with jewels (石) where printed, the case material (SS, HSS, SGP, HGP, GC, ASGP/AWGP/APDP/ACRP A-grade plated, WGP, PDP, GPDP, SILV silver, GF/WGF, 14K, ALM light alloy, PC plastic, TINSB titanium), a crystal/feature line, the case code printed as CCCC<case-dial> (the bracketed part is kept as caseDialCode, the full line in `code`) and a box with either the bracelet/chain/cord code (X…) or the strap width in mm. `caliber` is the printed movement number, or the four-digit prefix of the case code where the movement is printed as a family code; family codes with a shorter prefix (11S, 17QS, 87ST, 88ST) leave it blank. No CCCC-NNNN case–movement ref is printed. The scan skips printed pages 10, 18, 40, 102, 103 and 128, and scan pages 126–138 are a second scan of printed pages 118–131. On the two diver pages the ref and price are printed in light blue over an underwater photo and cannot be read in this scan; the pair-watch page (printed 101) repeats six models with ref and price only.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, every pictured watch boxed on per-page check sheets and its ref, price, movement, jewels, case, case code, bracelet/strap box and dial verified against caption crops.
